references.text: The description of how the Lord's ark was to be carried around the city by the priests, providing context for verse 11 where the ark is actually carried around.
The continuation of the process where they marched around the city once a day for six days, and on the seventh day they marched around seven times.
Instructions regarding the carrying poles for the ark, showing how the ark of the covenant was to be transported.
The Lord's ark going before the people on their journey, paralleling the ark's central role in the procession around Jericho.
Earlier instructions to follow the ark of the covenant and the priests' role in carrying it, preparing for the event at Jericho.
God's ark in the camp and its significance for the people of Israel, highlighting the ark's central role in the life of the nation.
